item.title: Dr. Cheryl Edinbyrd; Her life story
item.description: Elevate presents the inspiring life journey of Dr. Cheryl Edinbyrd - a story of resilience, determination, and purpose. Tune in to witness the power of perseverance as we honor her remarkable achievements..

item.title: Start Dreaming Big
item.description: Let’s figure out what we want and get it! Let’s open to some possibilities and start something small and work on something big. We’ve let go of whatever we thought was standing in our way, it’s time to dream big. Visit motivatingradio.com for more Motivational Minute episodes.

item.title: Dealing with Change
item.description: Be very clear about what you want and listen to these 5 quick steps to dealing with change.

item.title: Power of Choice with Elisha Rasmussen
item.description: Sometimes we might feel stuck for some reason but never lose the power of choice, the choice on how we look or visualize things, and move on with life! Listen to Elisha as she talks about the “Power of Choice.” Visit Motivating Radio for more episodes of Thinker Series.

item.title: Other People’s Money with Michael Lechter
item.description: Looking for funding? Learn how to find money for your projects and businesses! Michael Lechter's book, Other People's Money is part of the Rich Dad Poor Dad series.

item.title: Values and Priorities
item.description: Values and priorities are things that you give the most time, energy, and effort into.
